title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3
summary: Moonshot AI 发布 2.8 万亿参数 Kimi K3 模型权重（1.56TB），采用修改版 MIT 许可，要求月活超 1 亿或月收入超 2000 万美元的商业实体在界面显著标注“Kimi K3”。

extra.description: moonshotai/Kimi-K3 As promised earlier this month , Moonshot have released the weights for their excellent 2.8 trillion parameter Kimi K3. They're a hefty 1.56TB on Hugging Face. Kimi introduced their own janky modified version of the MIT license with K2 back in July 2025.
